subject.title: refactor: prune unsupported OPENCLAW env overrides

question: Should this PR preserve the packaged `OPENCLAW_TELEMETRY` override while pruning the other seven variables, or intentionally retire it with a coordinated launcher migration?
rationale: The current code names packaged launcher control as an existing contract, so deciding to remove it is an upgrade and privacy-behavior choice rather than a routine refactor judgment.

options.title: Preserve telemetry override
options.body: Keep `OPENCLAW_TELEMETRY` in this PR, remove the other proven-redundant paths, and migrate launchers separately with real upgrade proof.

options.title: Coordinate full retirement
options.body: Retire all eight only after every shipped launcher writes the persisted setting and a redacted upgrade run proves opt-out behavior remains intact.

recommendation.title: Preserve telemetry override
recommendation.body: Keep `OPENCLAW_TELEMETRY` in this PR, remove the other proven-redundant paths, and migrate launchers separately with real upgrade proof.
